title: Gonbad-e Qabus tomb tower, Gonbad-e Kavus
summary: Gonbad-e Qabus is a brick tomb tower near the ruined Ziyarid capital of Jorjan in north-eastern Iran, built in 1006 for the ruler Qabus ibn Voshmgir. UNESCO gives its height as 53 m on a base 17 m across, with ten flanges around the shaft and a conical roof. It became a model for later tomb towers.

uncertainty.note: UNESCO gives 1006 AD; the Iran Gazetteer reads the foundation inscription as 397 H, which it matches to 1006-1007. End is the present: the tower stands.

reviewer_note: Shape tower, round, with the 17 m base diameter from the ICOMOS evaluation (the plan is really a ten-flanged star). Height 53 m is UNESCO and ICOMOS; Iranica says 52 m with the roof and the Gazetteer 62 m including a 10 m mound. The 1006-1007 construction phase end is the inscription reading; the 'intact' phase start is the next year.
